notes.title: Limited Time Sale: Creatures Of War 40% off!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow survivalists, 

Creatures Of War is currently being discounted by 40% meaning you can grab this bad boy for less than $10! (Billy Mays Voice, RIP).

In other news Creatures Of War is actively being worked on. Currently the game is sitting on patch 1.03 with a few known bugs still existing in the game. The goal is to complete the level reworks and designs that will significantly change the way the game is played across 6 different levels. Some of the level changes will be very big and some of the changes will be small. The overall goal is to change up the pacing of the game in the back half of the levels. This is what is planned for 1.04 as well as updated maps to go with the updated levels. 

I have been getting a lot of advice on adding in a hip pouch / fanny pack that would expand the players inventory by four additional slots. I think this is a really good idea and would give the player the necessary space to have four weapons actively in the inventory while still being able to collect ample items throughout your level exploration endeavors.

I believe that idea will be implemented in version 1.05. For now what I have been doing is assessing how long the player goes in-between tram locations, IE the item box. I noticed that in the Metropolis building in the Acidic Lagoon that the player is no where near a tram for 20 minutes or more of gameplay. This made it exceptionally hard to collect all of the items or to prepare the player properly for upcoming ambushes, etc. This has been addressed with a brand new tram location for version 1.04. 

Anyways get it while its hot everyone,

Cheers,
Tim
Lead Developer: Creatures Of War
Chaos Entertainment

notes.title: Creatures Of War Update: 1.02 -> 1.03
notes.notes:
Hello Fellow Survivalists!

We’ve been on an absolute mission to enhance your experience in Creatures of War, and we’re thrilled to share the exciting updates we’ve been working on! Your feedback from the Steam forums and our Discord has been invaluable, and we can’t thank you enough for being such an engaged community. If you want to connect with us directly for bug reports or just to hang out, join our Discord here: https://discord.gg/Ku2sRKeSjT

What’s New in This Update?

This update is packed with fantastic improvements, including revamped maps, refined visceral attack mechanics, a seamless cloud save system, and audio normalization for cutscenes. Let’s dive into the details!

Map Adjustments:

We heard you loud and clear! Navigating the levels was a bit tricky without clear player markers. Well, no more getting lost! We’ve added player markers throughout every location in the game, so you’ll always know exactly where you are. Just check the map, and you’ll see your icon shining bright!

Visceral Attack Adjustments:

Get ready for some epic action! Our finishing move, the Visceral Attack, has been reconfigured for optimal gameplay. We’ve rebounded the keys to CTRL for keyboard/mouse and R2/RT for gamepads. No more accidental rope climbs or reloads when you want to unleash your fury! This change paves the way for even more customization in the future based on your feedback.

Cloud Save Improvements:

We’ve supercharged our cloud save system! Previously, saves weren’t communicating properly between Linux/Mac and Windows. Now, you can effortlessly switch between your PC and Steam Deck without losing progress. Play anywhere, anytime—your saves are now fully synced!

Audio Normalization:

We know how important immersive cutscenes are to your gameplay experience. That’s why we’ve taken the time to normalize audio levels across the board! Say goodbye to jarring volume shifts; our cutscenes will now deliver a consistent and engaging audio experience that keeps you glued to the action.

Minor Bug Fixes:

We’ve also tackled a host of minor bugs to make your gameplay smoother than ever! For instance, we’ve reduced the cost of 40MM grenades, making them a more enticing option for taking down those pesky foes. Every tweak is designed with you in mind!

What’s Next? Road Map Insights:

Looking ahead, we’re focused on enhancing creativity in later levels. Some areas need a little more excitement—think ambushes and jump scares! We’re committed to revamping these stretches before our next big update. Weapon balancing is also on our radar; we want every playstyle to feel rewarding. Plus, we’re bringing in some epic battle music to elevate those intense moments during ambushes. Get ready for an immersive sound experience that will have your adrenaline pumping!

Thank you for being part of our journey in Creatures of War. We can’t wait for you to dive into these updates and continue sharing your thoughts with us!

Cheers,
Tim
Lead Developer
Creatures Of War
Chaos Entertainment

notes.title: Creatures Of War Update: [1.00 -> 1.01]
notes.notes:
Creatures Of War went live on Wednesday evening and with the launch a few bugs were encountered, a few balance issues were noticed, and adjustments were needed. With that being said here are some of the fixes that will be implemented when downloading version 1.01. 

[list]
[*] The shotgun [HEARTSTOPPER] has had its reload speed increased by .15 seconds.
[*]Black Widow HP reduced by 20, they will now be 1 shot by all pistols. 
[*]Dilophosaurus HP reduced by 20%. They will not be the bullet sponges they once were. 
[*]Cutscene addition to make shooting down the stalactites in the caves more obvious.
[*]Late game boss HP reduction, for those who are not far into the game, I do not want to give away spoilers. 
[*]Late game boss persistency enacted. Certain bosses were respawning upon death, this should no longer occur. 
[*]Various combat rooms were awkward to fight in, those rooms have been adjusted. 
[*]Various fall through the level bugs have been adjusted.
[*]Player fast skipping and blacking out the screen forever bug has been fixed. 
[*]The bug where the triceratops kills you and you die while loading the caves putting the player into a zombie state has been resolved. 
[*]Various Grapple Points have been moved for more consistent landing locations.
[*]Various collider adjustments to ensure the player does not get stuck. 
[*]Adjustments to grenades and traps, they now will work under more conditions, previously they were operating ineffectively in water locations.
[*]Various ambush adjustments, creatures were spawning and de-activating, more consistency should be noticed across the board. 
[*]General balance changes. 
[/list]

Over the next few weeks I will be keeping a close eye on everything that is going on from a player perspective. If anything feels unbalanced, unfair, or generally not fun, I will be on it very quickly.  My next step is to get item combining put into the game. Currently if you have 1 small water bottle and 4 small water bottles, you cannot combine them. I mean to fix this and add the combination ability into the UI. This will make item management when not near an item box / fast travel location a much easier process. I will also be looking to add additional balance changes to weapons, enemies, ambushes, etc. In the near future I will be putting together a full road map for Creatures Of War bringing us from the 1.01 Release of today all the way to the 2.0 Release which will be known as the "Creatures Of War: Definitive Edition". 

That is all for now!

Cheers,
Tim

notes.title: Creatures of War: Unleash the Horror!
notes.notes:
🎉 Game Is Releasing Now: Creatures of War! 🎉

The wait is finally over! Creatures of War, the highly anticipated 2D Jurassic Survival Horror game, is here! Prepare yourself for an exhilarating journey into a world where danger lurks around every corner, and survival is your only option.

Face the Ultimate Predators

In Creatures of War, you’ll encounter massive dinosaurs that can take you out at any moment. Every step you take could lead to a deadly encounter with lethal hybrid creatures like the Giant Asian Hornoraptor and the terrifying Stoprion. These monstrous foes are not just formidable; they are relentless predators that will eviscerate you in half a second if given the chance. In this game, danger is more than an understatement—it’s a constant, heart-pounding reality!

Epic Gameplay Experience

Expect an action-packed adventure that will take approximately 15-20 hours for your initial playthrough. But that's just the beginning! The game delivers exceptionally high value for its cost, offering incredible replay-ability thanks to a vast array of weapons. You can experiment with countless weapon combinations to conquer challenges in multiple ways. This means you can beat the game using one set of weapons and then return for another playthrough with an entirely different arsenal, keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting each time!

Stunning Visuals Crafted with Precision

The artwork in Creatures of War has been meticulously created in Photoshop, featuring exceptionally high-fidelity sprites that can reach up to 8,000 pixels at times. This level of detail allows for stunning visuals that showcase intricate striations in the musculature of the enemies you fight and the bumps and folds within the environment. It’s a visual experience that pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in a 2D game!

Immersive Sound Design

The sound effects have been built from the ground up, with most of them custom-created to represent each enemy, interaction, and experience within the game on a deeply personal level. We worked hand-in-hand with combat operative Mike Ludwig to understand what he would be experiencing at any given moment, crafting gorgeous SFX that enhance your emotional connection to the gameplay.

Dynamic Musical Score

The music has been meticulously composed by analyzing each level and identifying the emotions players might feel under different circumstances. Did you just survive a massive ambush? What music should accompany that moment? Are you in the middle of an intense fight? We’ve ensured that our soundtrack dynamically adjusts to amplify feelings of dread and intensity throughout your journey. This organic, brick-by-brick method stays true to our roots while enhancing your overall experience.

Optimized for All Systems

We’ve carefully tested and optimized the backend coding to ensure that Creatures of War runs smoothly on lower-end systems without sacrificing quality. This survival horror RPG draws inspiration from classics like Resident Evil 4, featuring hundreds of systems working together seamlessly to immerse you in this prehistoric nightmare. Thanks to our attention to detail, you’ll be able to enjoy this game even on devices like the Steam Deck, all while experiencing stunning 8K resolution images downscaled to 4K.

Engaging Narrative Inspired by Horror Masterpieces

The narrative of Creatures of War draws inspiration from iconic horror masterpieces such as Alien, Dead Space, Resident Evil, and Dino Crisis. The story centers around a key target: the president's son, who goes missing during a tactical mission. A combat team is dispatched to find him, but things go horribly wrong. Enter advanced combat operative Mike Ludwig, who must unravel this chaotic mess. Expect twists and surprises that lead seamlessly into potential sequels!

Looking Ahead: A Vision for the Future

While the future remains uncertain, my time spent working on Creatures of War represents a significant chapter in my life that I will never forget. I dream of creating sequels, as the game concludes in a way that paves the path for future narratives. However, I also recognize the need to focus on my personal life and navigate the financial uncertainties that come with being an indie game developer. The success of this game—through sales, reviews, and community reception—is crucial for me as I aim to maintain high standards within our gaming community. I am committed to continuously patching and improving the game post-launch to ensure it remains top-notch for players everywhere.

A Heartfelt Thank You

I want to take a moment to acknowledge everyone who worked tirelessly on this project: Jay Suong, Ashleii Kono, Cody Munn, Gregg McManus, Adolfo Almonte, and Eric Hartman. Your dedication has made this vision a reality!

Join Us on This Journey!

Cheers to the launch of Creatures of War! I am honored to share this creative vision that has been five years in the making. I truly hope you enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed developing it.
For any feedback or constructive criticism about the game, please feel free to reach out at Tim@creaturesofwar.com.
Cheers,
Timothy Brunetto
Owner: Chaos Entertainment
Lead Developer: Creatures Of War

notes.title: Creatures Of War: Final Push
notes.notes:
Hello fellow survivalists,

Creatures A war is going to be launching in less than two weeks! 

As of right now a new demo was just released! This will be our final demo update. This update includes a new gore system, balance tweaks, backend fixes, skipping adjustments, additional save slots, and more. 

The new gore system detects the type of circumstance that killed the player and then applies proper skin and animation adjustments at runtime to determine the type of death that should occur to the player. Feel free to let the "Triceratops" kill you a few times to see some of the new animations at work! 

In addition to the new gore system the team has been hard at work balancing, polishing, adjusting, and doing whatever it takes to get "Creatures Of War" ready for launch. Some of the more interesting bits to share with you all includes the boss fight adjustments I have been making personally. 

The Spinosaurus boss fight for example had a bridge that could be "camped on" quite easily to avoid having to fight the creature where he could use his full arsenal of attacks. I realized how easy it was to abuse this fight and came up with the idea to have the geysers in the room to produce steam that would damage the player over time if they remained on the bridge. This then forces the player to use the zipline nearby to relocate to the floor where the Spinosaurus is located, and thus the fight ensues, face to face.

Simple gameplay adjustments such as the previous example have been added all over the game to make "Creatures of War" a more fun and enjoyable playthrough experience for every to take in on October 23rd.  

For now the team will be tirelessly working until the finish line. While there is still a lot of work left to be done, I believe it is possible to get everything strung together in time for release. I am very excited for this opportunity moving forward and can't wait to share "Creatures Of War" to everyone in the near future. 

Cheers,
Tim
Owner: Chaos Entertainment
Lead Developer: Creatures Of War

notes.title: Exciting Updates to "Creatures Of War" Demo!
notes.notes:
[u][b]Exciting Updates to "Creatures Of War" Demo!
[/b][/u]

Greetings, fellow survivors! 

We're thrilled to share the latest improvements to the "Creatures Of War" demo. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we've been hard at work enhancing your experience.

[b][u]Gameplay Enhancements
[/u][/b]
We've addressed the healing item concerns by introducing purchasable healing items from the merchant at a premium cost. This addition should provide a better balance to the game's challenge.
To keep you on your toes, we've implemented ambush events throughout the level. These unexpected encounters will create more intense horror scenarios, breaking up the predictability of predetermined creature placements.

[u][b]Visual and Audio Upgrades
[/b][/u]
The demo's aesthetics and immersion have been significantly improved with adjustments to lighting and art within the level. We've also updated the main menu theme, replacing it with a creepier, more gripping song that sets the tone right from the start.

[u][b]Item pickups now feature color-coding for easier identification:
[/b][/u]
Red for weapons
Green for healing items
Light red for traps and grenades

This change allows for quick visual recognition of item types before pickup.

[u][b]User Interface Improvements
[/b][/u]
We've made substantial improvements to menu interactions for both keyboard/mouse and gamepad users. You'll notice crisper interactions, improved click response times, and limited UI box persistence for a smoother navigation experience.
New keyboard commands have been introduced, including the ability to use Tab to swiftly explore different menu types such as treasure, map, settings, and Bestiary tabs.

[u][b]Technical Improvements
[/b][/u]
Dinosaur death animations have been revamped to eliminate competing animations in edge cases, particularly when using the knife.

We've also made significant backend performance improvements, reducing garbage throws and script loads. This should result in a better player experience, especially on lower-end PCs.
Looking Ahead

Work on the other levels continues at a steady pace. We've entered the polishing phase and expect to complete the entire game within the next 6 weeks. After that, we'll focus on extensive playtesting and final polish before release.

Thank you for your continued support of "Creatures Of War"! If you're enjoying the demo, please consider wishlisting the game on our Steam page.

Cheers,
Tim

notes.title: Massive Update to "Creatures Of War Demo" – Get Ready for an Epic Experience!
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41307072/f8a47de506447b3d767d8c3c4caabee0bbf82422.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41307072/5c7ba1a52721206823d588b1551751263121cd62.jpg[/img][/url]Hello Warriors,

We are thrilled to announce a massive update for Creatures Of War! Our team has been hard at work refining and enhancing the game based on your feedback and our vision for a more immersive and challenging experience. Here’s what you can expect in this update:

1. Reduced Inventory Capacity
Managing your inventory just became more strategic! We've reduced the overall capacity, meaning you’ll need to make smarter choices about what to carry. Prioritize essentials and think ahead!

2. Introduction of the Storage Box
To complement the new inventory system, we’ve introduced storage boxes. Use these to stash items and free up space in your main inventory. Plan your loadouts and make every slot count.

3. Ammunition Management
Ammunition is now more precious than ever. Every bullet matters, so make your shots count and conserve ammo whenever possible. Strategy and precision are key to survival.

4. Importance of Heavy Weapons
Heavy weapons are designed for larger creatures. Using them on smaller enemies might leave you underpowered when facing bigger threats. Choose your weapons wisely to avoid tough situations with only a pistol in hand.

5. Revamped Music Fidelity
We’ve overhauled the demo music for a richer, more immersive audio experience. The new soundtrack will pull you deeper into the world of Creatures Of War.

6. Creature Impact Moments
Prepare for dramatic creature introductions with custom intro cutscenes. These moments will showcase the tenacity and threat level of the creatures you encounter, adding to the game's tension and excitement.

7. Greater Game Balancing
We’ve tweaked enemy HP totals to ensure a smoother difficulty progression. These changes aim to maintain the challenge while keeping the gameplay fun and engaging.

8. Optimized Tutorials
To help you get up to speed quickly, we’ve moved around tutorials for better onboarding. These changes ensure you learn game elements at the right time, making your initial experience more intuitive and enjoyable.

9. Increased Ambush Events
Stay on your toes! We’ve added more ambush events to keep you on edge. These surprise encounters will test your reflexes and preparedness, adding to the survival horror atmosphere.

10. Enhanced Inventory Fidelity
Our new and improved inventory screens provide more detailed information. The updated evidence screen now clearly outlines mission objectives, helping you stay focused on your goals.

11. Countless Features and Bug Fixes
We’ve made numerous feature additions and bug fixes to polish the game. Those who played the previous demo versions will notice a significant improvement in the overall gameplay experience.

We can’t wait for you to dive into these updates and experience all the new content and improvements. Thank you for your continued support and feedback – it’s been invaluable in shaping the game into what it is today.

Happy hunting, and see you on the battlefield!

Best,
The Creatures Of War Team

notes.title: Unleashing a New Nightmare: The Evolution of 'Creatures of War
notes.notes:
Greetings, fearless survivors! We've emerged from the depths of development to share some spine-chilling updates about our survival horror masterpiece, "Creatures of War." Brace yourselves, as we've fine-tuned the game to deliver an even more intense and immersive experience.

1. User-Friendly Controls: A Breath of Fresh Air

One of the most significant changes we've made is a complete overhaul of the control system. We understand the importance of fluid, user-friendly controls in a survival horror game, and we've heard your feedback loud and clear. No more clunky movements - now, a simple button press triggers your character's sprint, giving you more control and responsiveness in those heart-pounding moments.

2. Aiming on the Move: Tactical Survival

Survival requires quick thinking and strategic moves. In response to player demands, we've unlocked a new level of tactical gameplay - you can now aim your weapon while walking. No longer confined to standing still to take aim, you can seamlessly navigate the perilous environment while keeping an eye on your surroundings. It's a game-changer that adds an extra layer of strategy to your survival arsenal.

4. Guiding Lights: Tutorial Prompts for the Lost Souls

For those embarking on this harrowing journey, fear not! We've added tutorial prompts to guide you through the initial stages of the game. These helpful hints will ensure that even newcomers can navigate the darkness with confidence, teaching you the ropes and maximizing your chances of survival.

5. Weapons in New Hands: Swapped Weapon Locations

The familiar is now the unfamiliar! To keep you on your toes, we've swapped the locations of some key weapons. Don't get too comfortable - adapting to these changes may be the difference between life and an unspeakable fate.

6. Squashing the Bugs: Jumping to New Heights

In the world of "Creatures of War," every move counts. We've diligently addressed jumping bugs that may have hindered your progress in the past. Prepare to leap into action without fear of unexpected glitches, ensuring a smoother and more immersive experience.

7. Many More Nightmares Await: A Glimpse into the Shadows

These changes are just the tip of the iceberg. "Creatures of War" is more terrifying and gripping than ever before, and we can't wait for you to plunge into the darkness and face the nightmares that lurk within. Stay vigilant, survivors, and may your courage be your guide in this relentless battle for survival.

Are you ready to face the creatures that dwell in the shadows? Your journey awaits, and the horrors have only just begun. Sharpen your instincts, fortify your resolve, and brace yourself for an unparalleled survival horror experience in "Creatures of War." The nightmare is real, but so is your will to survive.

notes.title: Creatures Of War: Squashing Bugs and Enhancing Gameplay Experience
notes.notes:
Introduction:

In the dark and enthralling universe of Creatures Of War, survival is paramount as players navigate through a prehistoric landscape teeming with danger and mystery. As we gear up to enhance the gaming experience, our development team has diligently identified several crucial bugs that need immediate attention. By addressing these issues, we are dedicated to providing a smoother, more immersive, and exhilarating gameplay adventure for all our passionate players. Join us as we delve into the details of the bugs set to be exterminated in the coming weeks and the comprehensive strategies we're implementing to ensure a seamless gaming experience.

Known Bugs and Issues:

[PLAYER_JUMPING_ELEVATOR] - The issue of a fatal auto-death when jumping off a descending elevator due to discrepancies in the elevator's velocity calculations is at the forefront of our bug-fixing agenda. By reevaluating the velocity calculations and the interaction between the player and the elevator, we aim to ensure a seamless gaming experience without any untimely deaths.

[PLAYER_JUMPING] - Addressing the discrepancies in the player's jump behavior on different types of slopes is a key priority. By recalibrating the jump velocities on both upward and downward slopes, we aim to create a more consistent and balanced gameplay experience. Additionally, we are committed to resolving the jump stutter issue encountered in specific environmental contexts.

[JUMPING_THROUGH_NODE_MAP] - Rectifying the issue of players inadvertently falling through the level during specific jumping sequences at the final tram station demands a comprehensive review of the nodemap and collider settings. We are dedicated to ensuring that the nodemap effectively restrains the player's movements, preventing any unintended falls beyond the designated game terrain.

[SPIDER_DAMAGE_AFTER_DEATH] - The persistence of player damage upon encountering the "Spider Ambush Variants" demands a thorough examination of the relevant game scripts. By scrutinizing the parameters related to the "Fall_Attack_State" and ensuring appropriate state transitions, we aim to provide a smoother and more coherent combat experience for our players.

[CONTROLLER_ADJUSTMENTS] - Enhancing the overall control scheme to optimize gameplay efficiency is critical. By reassigning specific actions to appropriate controller buttons and addressing the inconsistencies related to the use of certain controls, we seek to provide a more intuitive and immersive control experience for our players.

Implementation Strategies and Demo Update:

To address these critical bugs and enhance the overall gaming experience, our development team is actively integrating comprehensive bug-fixing strategies into the current build pipeline. We are committed to thorough testing and validation to ensure that the upcoming fixes seamlessly integrate with the game's existing framework. Moreover, we are excited to announce that the most recent demo builds with these bug fixes will be available for download on the Creatures Of War Steam Page, offering players an early glimpse into the optimized and enhanced gameplay experience.

Conclusion:

As we embark on this journey of enhancing the Creatures Of War gaming experience, we extend our heartfelt gratitude to our dedicated player community for their continued support and feedback. With our unwavering commitment to delivering a truly immersive and seamless gaming adventure, we look forward to providing an unparalleled and unforgettable experience in the world of Creatures Of War. Stay tuned for more updates and announcements as we continue to evolve and refine the game, setting new standards for the survival horror genre.

notes.title: Creatures Of War Gameplay Trailer
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=rhQPykRCiQk;full][/previewyoutube]

The Creatures Of War gameplay trailer is finally here. If you were wondering why the forums have been so quiet, well the team and I have been hard at work polishing the core features. These pillars have finally gotten to the point where I thought a gameplay trailer would properly capture the essence of Creatures Of War. 

In each new clip the player is wielding a different weapon. We focused on giving the player a lot of different weapons to choose from to allow you to survive in the style that best suits your playstyle. That is why we showcased the sniper head shots, the cryogrenade freezing the Velociraptor, and the sub-machine guns. We also showed a lot different creatures because we wanted to showcase how diverse the enemies can be. In one of the clips you are fighting a mighty Spinosaurus 10X the size of you, in another sequence you are shooting a compy that is 1/5 your size with a shotgun. Yet whether the enemy you are encountering is big or small, in the right circumstances, anything can overwhelm you. 

At a later date we will create another trailer that will focus on the survival horror elements of the game. Resource management, sad survivor stories discovered through audio and text logs, and spooky areas that lead you into tense hair raising situations. 

Let me know what you think of the trailer!

notes.title: Creatures Of War Is Here!
notes.notes:
[b]Creatures Of War[/b] is a violent, action-packed, Metroidvania-inspired, adventure RPG. You’ll explore a massive island, savagely combatting unfathomable monstrosities in 2D souls/doom combat. No Mercy. Kill, Upgrade, or Perish.

[b]Electrifying Combat:[/b] Unleash the power of your arsenal. Swiftly dodge your foe's attack and counter with a shotgun blast to the face. Scope in from distance and blast your enemy into ruin with a bolt action rifle. Flanked from two sides? Freeze your enemies in place with a cryogrenade and mow down the opposing enemies with an automatic 20MM grenade launcher. The combinations are endless.

[b]Explore Ko'Verest Island:[/b] Every biome that you'll visit is ruggedly unique and tough, bursting with new creatures, treasures, and secrets to uncover. But Be Warned: Some secrets are better off left alone.

[b]Unravel The Truth:[/b] Across the island's luscious landscape lies an expansive network of abandoned buildings. You have been sent in to investigate the island as well as the disappearance of Delta squad. As the fierce combat operative Mike Ludwig, it is up to you to uncover the tragic events that took place and to conquer its evils.

[b]Ascend Your Weaponry:[/b] Collect treasures and currency to fund weapon upgrades that will tear down even the biggest enemies. Sometimes all you need is a little extra firepower.

[b]Augmentation Successful:[/b] Herbs collected throughout the island can be used for brewing tonics and potions. Some will temporarily buff your resistances to certain elements while others will permanently increase your health or stamina.

[b]The Story:[/b]

Delta squad has been sent in to investigate the Satellite Images of a remote island in the Gulf of Terhana.

Sometime in the middle of last night, Delta Squad's helicopter went…. Missing. Fear is spreading that the helicopter was shot down. Their safety is now seriously in question. Mike Ludwig has been sent in to rescue any surviving members of Delta squad. During his stay, Mike hopes to unravel the mystery behind Ko'Verest island.[previewyoutube=c56pkP4kDXc;full][/previewyoutube]
